component.name: Spaced Update
component.summary: Update Spaced Linux and its applications

description.p: Spaced Update checks APT and Flatpak together, lets you choose the updates to apply, and shows clear progress while the host system performs the work.
This Flatpak is intended for Spaced Linux. It uses the distribution's small policy-controlled host helper for privileged system updates.
Adds complete AppStream metadata so SpacedBazaar and other Flatpak stores can index, search, and display Spaced Update from a repository.
